mapper.select: INSERT INTO TripInfo SET regDate = NOW(), updateDate = NOW(), tripName = '대전여행', tripRegion = #{tripRegion}, tripStartDate = #{tripStartDate}, tripEndDate = #{tripEndDate}, memberId = #{memberId};
INSERT INTO tripDay SET tripId = #{tripId}, dayIndex = #{dayIndex}, `date` = #{date}, startTime = #{startTime}, endTime = #{endTime}

SELECT TP.*, TL.*, TLP.pictureUrl AS extra__pictureUrl, TLT.typeName AS extra__locationType FROM tripPlace AS TP INNER JOIN tripLocation AS TL ON TP.tripLocationId = TL.id LEFT JOIN tripLocationPicture AS TLP ON TL.id = TLP.tripLocationId INNER JOIN tripLocationType AS TLT ON TL.locationTypeId = TLT.id WHERE tripDayId = #{tripDayId} GROUP BY TP.id

SELECT TP.*, TL.*, TLP.pictureUrl AS extra__pictureUrl, TLT.typeName AS extra__locationType FROM tripPlace AS TP INNER JOIN tripLocation AS TL ON TP.tripLocationId = TL.id LEFT JOIN tripLocationPicture AS TLP ON TL.id = TLP.tripLocationId INNER JOIN tripLocationType AS TLT ON TL.locationTypeId = TLT.id WHERE tripDayId = ( SELECT id FROM tripDay WHERE dayIndex = #{index} AND tripId = #{tripId} ) GROUP BY TP.id

SELECT TP.*, TL.*, TLP.pictureUrl AS extra__pictureUrl, TLT.typeName AS extra__locationType, TD.dayIndex FROM tripPlace AS TP INNER JOIN tripLocation AS TL ON TP.tripLocationId = TL.id LEFT JOIN tripLocationPicture AS TLP ON TL.id = TLP.tripLocationId INNER JOIN tripLocationType AS TLT ON TL.locationTypeId = TLT.id INNER JOIN tripDay AS TD ON TP.tripDayId = TD.id WHERE tripDayId IN ( SELECT id FROM tripDay WHERE tripId = #{tripId} ) GROUP BY TP.id ORDER BY TP.tripDayId, TP.startTime;
INSERT INTO tripPlace SET tripLocationId = #{id}, tripDayid = #{tripDayId}, startTime = #{startTime}, endTime = #{endTime}, duration = #{moveDuration};
SELECT * FROM tripDay WHERE dayIndex = #{dayIndex} AND tripId = #{tripId};
